sloka: लोचने कोपसम्रक्ते वर्णम् पूर्वोचितम् जहत् ।कोपाभिभूतः सहसा सम्तापमशुभम् गतः ॥२-३५-२॥
transliteration: locane kopasamrakte varṇam pūrvocitam jahat ।kopābhibhūtaḥ sahasā samtāpamaśubham gataḥ ॥2-35-2॥

translations.english: Overcome with anger, charioteer Sumantra started shaking his head and sighing off and on, crushing his palms and grinding his teeth. His eyes turned red due to anger. Overcome with a sudden, ominous grief, the complexion of his face turned red. Sumantra understood the mind of Dasaratha. With sharp arrows of words as if piercing the heart of Kaikeyi, he denounced her in exceptionally harsh words which, like thunderbolt, cut her to the quick:
